sourceRows.title: Dark mode flickers on first paint
sourceRows.description: The theme is read from localStorage after hydration, so the light palette shows for a frame before the dark one takes over. Most visible on slow connections.

sourceRows.title: Weekly activity digest by email
sourceRows.description: One email on Monday morning: what shipped, what moved, what stalled. Opt-in per project, unsubscribe in one click.

sourceRows.title: Inline editing of issue titles on the board
sourceRows.description: Renaming a ticket takes four clicks today. Double-click the title, type, press Enter.

sourceRows.title: Remember the last used filter per project
sourceRows.description: Filters reset on every visit. Keep the last one per project, and let a single click clear it.

sourceRows.title: Bulk-assign issues from the board
sourceRows.description: Select several rows, then assign them in one go instead of opening each ticket.

sourceRows.title: Add keyboard shortcuts to the command palette
sourceRows.description: Power users live in the palette but still reach for the mouse to run an action. Show the shortcut next to each row, and make it work from anywhere in the app.

sourceRows.title: Rework the onboarding checklist
sourceRows.description: Only one person in ten finishes the current checklist. Cut it to three steps and let people skip straight to the board.

sourceRows.title: Cache avatar lookups on the members endpoint
sourceRows.description: Every board load resolves the same handful of accounts one round-trip at a time. A short in-memory TTL removes the N+1.

sourceRows.title: Fix timezone drift on due dates
sourceRows.description: A due date set at 23:00 in Paris shows as the day before for anyone west of UTC. Store the date, not the instant.

sourceRows.title: Persist the sidebar collapsed state
sourceRows.description: Collapsing the sidebar only lasts until the next page load. Remember the choice per account, not per tab.

sourceRows.title: Slack notifications for mentions
sourceRows.description: Being mentioned in a comment should reach people where they already are. Direct message first, channel routing later.

sourceRows.title: Public roadmap page
sourceRows.description: A read-only page showing what shipped, what is in progress and what is planned — fed by the board, with no second list to maintain.

sourceRows.title: Drag issues between columns
sourceRows.description: Moving a ticket meant opening it and changing its status. Drag the card, drop it in the column, done.

sourceRows.title: Invite teammates by email
sourceRows.description: Send an invitation from the project settings, with a link that expires after seven days.

sourceRows.title: Two-factor authentication for the workspace
sourceRows.description: Enterprise prospects raise it on every call. TOTP and recovery codes first; single sign-on is a separate conversation.

sourceRows.title: Audit log for workspace admins
sourceRows.description: Who changed what, and when. Ninety days of retention covers what we sell today.

sourceRows.title: Merge two accounts created with the same email
sourceRows.description: People sign up with Google, then again with a password, and end up with two half-empty workspaces.

sourceRows.title: Export a project as CSV
sourceRows.description: Board data people can drop into a spreadsheet: one row per ticket, with its status, assignee and effort.
